name: Veal and Sago Soup
author: Fannie Merritt Farmer (1896)
steps: Order meat from market, very finely chopped.
Pick over and remove particles of fat.
Cover meat with water, bring slowly to boiling-point, and simmer two hours, skimming occasionally; strain and reheat.
Soak sago one-half hour in enough cold water to cover, stir into hot stock, boil thirty minutes, and add milk; then pour mixture slowly on yolks of eggs, slightly beaten.

culture.text: From The Boston Cooking-School Cook Book (1896) by Fannie Merritt Farmer. It popularized level, standardized measurements (cups and spoons) in American home kitchens, and stayed one of the best-selling cookbooks in the United States for decades.
